statements.status_notes: GitHub advisory GHSA-qqj6-54q6-cxv6 documents CVE-2026-86597 (sensitive data in Snowflake Go driver log files). Scout reports no fixed release on the v1 module line linked into the Vault binary for the optional Snowflake database secrets engine; upstream documents remediation on github.com/snowflakedb/gosnowflake v2.2.0, which is a major-module migration from the v1 import path Vault currently uses. Compatibility assessment and a dependency migration are pending.
